core.learn.label: Hack learn secondary actions
core.learn.pendingSecondary: Secondary command change is pending. Write and refresh it before previewing learning.
core.learn.pendingLearning: Learning is staged. Write and refresh, or undo pending changes before another preview.
core.learn.unavailable: Empty/unverified command, unsupported identity or unavailable tables: learning is disabled.
core.learn.allLearned: All valid action positions are already learned. No edit will be created.
core.learn.missingNames: Official action names are incomplete; learning cannot be staged.
core.learn.hint: Equipped secondary command only. Preview and stage, then confirm the dangerous write separately. No JP, job, passive or empty-slot edits.
core.learn.warning: Experimental: sets only this command’s nonempty action bits, preserving existing bits and passives. Weapon/action conditions still apply. Three roster copies are written and read back; working copies, battles and saves are NOT verified and may overwrite the result. Writes are not atomic: failure may leave partial changes, with no automatic retry. Staging retains originals for Undo; writing uses the existing save-backup mechanism.
core.learn.shared: Shared k0: this is the character’s shared base-job/special-command learning region, NOT an independent region for this secondary command. Other commands interpret the same positions as learned; cross-command effects cannot be isolated.
core.learn.invalid: Learning authorization expired or identity, generation, equipped command, tables, original values or mirrors changed. Undo pending edits and refresh the preview.
core.learn.partial: Learning write/readback failed and may be partially applied. The original baseline was not reset; authorization was revoked. Read again and inspect.
core.learn.writeWarning: Only bytes in three roster copies were verified. Working copies may overwrite them; actual actions, battles and saves remain unverified.
core.error.secondaryHack: Secondary Hack authorization was revoked or does not match this edit. Select the command again.
core.skill.hackWarning: Experimental cross-character command: no abilities are learned. Its ability list may be empty or unusable; weapon/ability conditions and game revalidation still apply.
